answer_1.quote: The visual question answering (VQA) task aims to provide a natural language answer to a question based on a given image.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answer to a question based on a given image

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the accuracy of VLMs' responses to ambiguous questions based on the widely adopted VQA Score and Exact Match (EM) metrics.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 is used to simulate the "user" role, to provide user feedback ξ i , i ∈ {1, • • • , n} when VLM poses a clarification question, as shown in Figure (b).
methods: assessing semantic similarity of clarification questions

answer_4.quote: We recruit 12 volunteers to manually select visual questions that exhibit ambiguity and align with real-world scenes, as detailed in Appendix C.
answer_4.guideline: The questionnaire for human quality filtering includes three questions: 1) Does the constructed ambiguous question introduce actual ambiguity? 2) Does the reference clarification question provide additional information that helps generate an answer? 3) Is it possible that the user could express the intent in real-world scenes?
